description: This file defines the LeaveDecorator class, which provides a higher-level interface for accessing and manipulating Leave entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to set employee info, leave type, retrieve leave status, date, duration, times, and last comments, utilizing various traits and external services.

classes.name: LeaveDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Leave entity, providing methods for setting related entities, formatting attributes, retrieving status, duration, times, and associated comments, utilizing various helper traits and external services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a given Leave entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee for the Leave based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the LeaveType for the Leave based on its ID.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the formatted leave status string.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusName
methods.description: Returns the raw leave status name in uppercase.

methods.name: getLeaveDate
methods.description: Returns the leave date formatted as Y-m-d.

methods.name: getLeaveDuration
methods.description: Returns the leave duration description based on the duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time formatted as H:i if the duration type specifies time.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time formatted as H:i if the duration type specifies time.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment associated with the leave.
